method: Actual final PNG viewed and compared to real empty blog baseline, complete submitted prompt/history, GEN-005 contract and current templates/models/service guards. Source-derived selected detail is not treated as runtime evidence.

Clean metadata status, disabled save, enabled private in-page preview (eye corrected), explicit publish and forward edit-original action consistent. No publish-update/withdraw or preview content in closed never-published draft state.

All seven metadata bindings retained: title, summary, category, tags, cover, pinned and slug. Expanded cover subsection also retains actual image-choice/upload/crop entry and source-attachment-choice action, without opening hidden crop/file/asset dialogs.
Never-published slug remains editable; copy disabled for null post.url agrees with service.describe requiring published and enabled before returning public URL. No hidden CAS/version/hash input.

Site-off publication note, graph-preview timing, remove-draft and never-published status retained. Metadata save, note save, explicit publish snapshot and site-enable remain independent source behavior.

styleFindings.finding: Light raster texture/blue shading, approximate scale and dense icon geometry are illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens, source toolbar overflow and sidebar resizing; this is not an exact CSS measurement or a regeneration blocker.

Native long image is 948×1660; all fields and bottom actions were readable in this review. It is not measured evidence of 1440-CSS-pixel desktop density/fit. Keep real source responsive, scrolling and shared CSS token behavior when implemented.

limitations: Static review does not prove guards, action execution, role enforcement, keyboard/focus, resizing or responsive behavior.
